notes:
## New features
- Right-click a section line in Plan, or a section view, and choose Edit coordinates to enter exact endpoint X/Y positions in model metres. The dialog shows length and model bearing, supports reversing direction, and applies the change as one undoable edit.

## Changes
- Section ground uses a soft neutral fill, subtle diagonal hatching and a clear terrain surface line in previews and exports.

## Bug fixes
- Section contour calculations and refreshes exclude both basemap layers. Basemap controls are disabled in section views; returning to Plan restores the selected layers and their appearance.
- Changing the Plan receiver height no longer marks an independent section calculation stale. Previously saved 0.17.0 section signatures remain compatible, while section-line and acoustic-input changes still require recalculation.
- Deleting a section removes its workspace and visibility references from every sheet and clears its cached grids. Undo restores the section and its saved workspace settings. Calculated snapshots remain retained evidence.
